messages:
alex: Hey @maria @dave — can someone take a quick look at PR #1892? Tokenizer offset fix + quant profile for spline-7b. Want to merge before tomorrow's canary.

maria: dropping link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1892>

maria: skimmed it — one minor comment about padding logic in tokenize.py, otherwise looks clean :+1:

dave: will review in ~1hr. do you have perf numbers after quant? curious about latency/TOK throughput

alex: ran microbench on g4dn, 2k tokens batch, ~18% CPU latency reduction after 4-bit profile. numbers in PR description. CI had one flaky integration, I pushed a fix.

infra-bot: CI result: build ✅  tests/integration — flaky_test (retry) ✅

alex: i re-ran tests locally:
```
python -m pytest tests/tokenizer_test.py::TestSplineTokenizer::test_padding
python -m scripts/bench_tokenize.py --model spline-7b --quant 4bit
```
both pass, bench attached in PR

maria: updated review — LGTM after your last commit. :shipit:

dave: also LGTM, left optional suggestion re: comment. will merge after canary window confirmed

jen: FYI ops — planning canary rollout tomorrow 09:00 PST, 2h window, auto-rollback on 3% latency regression. tagging @oncall

alex: thanks all — merging after 9:00 canary go-ahead. ping me if anything else. :rocket:
